scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/. dist/ && esbuild main.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --outfile=dist/assets/index.js && V=$(date +%s) && for f in dist/index.html dist/privacidad/index.html dist/terminos/index.html; do sed -i "s/?v=[0-9a-z]*/?v=$V/g" "$f"; done
